jobs.title: Senior Consultant - SAP BRIM CM
jobs.description:
Join Deloitte's SAP practice and build a career at the forefront of business transformation, where innovation, industry insight, and leading technology come together to solve complex challenges. You'll work with dynamic teams and leading organizations to modernize core processes, enable digital transformation, and help clients unlock lasting value through SAP\-enabled solutions.
   

  

 Recruiting for this role ends on 10/30/2026\.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Senior Consultant on the SAP team, you will support clients across the solution lifecycle, from business process assessment through design, build, testing, deployment, and post\-go\-live activities.
   

  

* Deliver SAP BRIM solutions with a focus on Convergent Mediation to support usage collection, transformation, enrichment, and distribution
* Assess business requirements and design usage\-to\-cash, billing, and charging processes
* Configure SAP BRIM Convergent Mediation for source ingestion, event transformation, validation, routing, aggregation, and error handling
* Support integration, testing, deployment, and stabilization activities across Convergent Mediation and adjacent SAP solutions, including Convergent Charging, Convergent Invoicing, Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable, Subscription Order Management, Sales and Distribution, Revenue Accounting and Reporting, and SAP S/4HANA Finance
* Facilitate workshops with business and technology stakeholders to define requirements, align on solution design, and support fit\-to\-standard decision\-making
* Drive production readiness activities, including monitoring, reconciliation, exception management, and performance optimization


**A successful candidate**
 A successful candidate would possess these skills:
   

  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others


**The team**
 Deloitte's SAP practice helps clients design, implement, and sustain SAP\-enabled transformations across core business functions. Our teams combine industry knowledge, functional experience, and technology capabilities to support first\-time implementations, business\-led enhancements, and large\-scale SAP S/4HANA programs.
   

  

 Professionals in the practice work with leading organizations across industries to modernize operations, improve process performance, and unlock value through cloud, automation, analytics, artificial intelligence, and machine learning.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* Bachelor's degree or Associate's degree plus 6\+ years of SAP, enterprise resource planning (ERP), billing, charging, revenue management, or consulting experience
* 5\+ years of SAP consulting experience supporting solution design and end\-to\-end delivery in a consulting firm, industry environment, or both
* 2\+ years of functional or techno\-functional experience with SAP Convergent Mediation / DigitalRoute Mediation Zone
* Participation in 2\+ full lifecycle SAP BRIM implementations involving mediation, billing, charging, or usage\-to\-cash processes
* Experience integrating Convergent Mediation with one or more of the following: Convergent Charging, Convergent Invoicing, FI\-CA, SOM, Sales and Distribution, RAR, or SAP S/4HANA Finance
* Experience with 1\+ SAP S/4HANA implementation, transformation, or migration programs, in a SAP BRIM environment
* Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve


 Preferred:
   

  

* Master's degree
* 2\+ years of client service delivery experience in a consulting or professional services firm supporting large enterprise transformation engagements
* Experience with usage\-to\-cashor subscription\-to\-bill processes
* Experience with source\-system integration from network, CRM, subscription, provisioning, or third\-party platforms
* Experience with data mapping, event lifecycle controls, reconciliation, exception management, and operational support
* Current SAP BRIM, SAP Convergent Mediation, or DigitalRoute Mediation Zone certification


 The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $110,700 to $218,300\.
   

  

 You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: SAP BRIM - Senior Consultant
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced, passionate pioneer in technology who wants to work in a collaborative environment? As an experienced
 **SAP BRIM \- Senior Consultant, Managed Services** 
 you will have the ability to share new ideas and collaborate on projects as a consultant without the extensive demands of travel. If so, consider an opportunity with Deloitte under our Project Delivery Talent Model. Project Delivery Model (PDM) is a talent model that is tailored specifically for long\-term, onsite client service delivery.
   

  

**Work You'll Do/Responsibilities**
**Deloitte is implementing a new SAP BRIM instance in a client environment, with go\-live expected in the first week of December. The project is focused on preparing the platform and business processes for a successful launch. Go\-live activities include final readiness checks, coordination across delivery teams, and transition planning to support a stable rollout.**
* Provide L2/L3 functional support for SAP BRIM (incidents, service requests, problems, changes) aligned to ITIL/AMS governance.
* Perform triage and root cause analysis for billing, charging, invoicing, subscription, and receivable\-related issues.
* Support and configure end\-to\-end BRIM processes:
* Primarily Convergent Mediation (CM) and usage data processing where applicable.
* Subscription Order Management (SOM) including subscription lifecycle management.
* Convergent Charging (CC) for usage\-based and recurring charging scenarios.
* Convergent Invoicing (CI) includes billable item processing, invoicing, and bill generation.
* Contract Accounting and Receivables Management (FI\-CA) includes collections, disputes, payment allocation, and account maintenance.
* Primary Skill set \- Convergent Mediation (CM) and usage data processing where applicable.
* Revenue and order\-to\-cash processing integration with SAP S/4HANA.
* Manage minor enhancements and configuration changes including pricing, charging plans, invoicing rules, business partner setup, account determination, and collections processes.
* Support monitoring and controls including billing jobs, invoice runs, charging processes, interface monitoring, reconciliation activities, and operational KPIs.
* Functional leadership from onshore. Lead a larger BRIM / SOM AMS team based in India
* Communicate regularly with Engagement Managers (Directors), project team members, and representatives from various functional and / or technical teams, including escalating any matters that require additional attention and consideration from engagement management.
* Independently and collaboratively lead client engagement workstreams focused on improvement, optimization, and transformation of processes including implementing leading practice workflows, addressing deficits in quality, and driving operational outcomes.


**The successful candidate would possess these skills:**
* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others


**The Team**
 Our Deloitte Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to deliver holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. Join our team of strategic advisers and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to collaborate with leading solution providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable heart\-of\-the\-business solutions.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Required**
* 7\+ years of experience working with SAP BRIM
* 7\+ years of experience providing functional support to SAP BRIM
* 7\+ years of experience integrating revenue into OTC processing with SAP S/4HANA
* Experience with onshore and managing offshore teams
* Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or related IT discipline; or equivalent experience
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
* Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve


**Preferred**
* Analytical/ Decision Making Responsibilities
* Analytical ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks into manageable work products
* Can operate independently or with minimum supervision
* Excellent Written and Communication Skills
* Ability to deliver technical demonstrations

jobs.title: SAP Solution Architect - OTC
jobs.description:
**About The Role**
 We are seeking an experienced
 **SAP Solution Architect – Order\-to\-Cash (OTC)** 
 to join our Global Capability Center in Bengaluru, India. In this role, you will lead the architecture, design, and transformation of SAP S/4HANA OTC capabilities across sales order management, pricing, fulfillment, billing, returns, and customer service. You will partner with Commercial Operations, Customer Service, and Technology teams to deliver scalable solutions that improve customer experience, operational efficiency, and revenue realization. The successful candidate will bring deep expertise in SAP OTC processes, SAP SD, pricing, ATP, billing, and Salesforce integration while driving business transformation through automation, analytics, and AI\-enabled capabilities.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Define and govern solution architecture across SAP Order\-to\-Cash processes.
* Design integrated OTC processes including customer master, quotations, sales orders, pricing, ATP, fulfillment, billing, returns, and customer service.
* Lead business transformation initiatives that improve customer experience, order execution, and revenue realization.
* Serve as the SAP OTC architecture lead for pricing, billing, order management, delivery processing, returns, and customer service capabilities.
* Drive Clean Core adoption and architecture governance within the OTC landscape.
* Partner with Commercial Operations, Customer Service, and Technology teams to align solutions with business objectives.
* Lead SAP\-Salesforce integration architecture supporting lead\-to\-order, quote\-to\-cash, customer synchronization, pricing, and order visibility.
* Define data, integration, reporting, and analytics strategies that enable end\-to\-end order visibility and performance measurement.
* Provide architecture leadership, mentor delivery teams, and guide solution decisions using SAP best practices and AI\-assisted engineering approaches.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in business, Information Technology, Engineering, Supply Chain, or related field.
* 10 years of experience delivering SAP Order\-to\-Cash solutions.
* 5 years of experience in Solution Architect, Enterprise Architect, or Lead Architect roles.
* Deep expertise in SAP S/4HANA OTC processes, including SAP SD, Pricing, ATP, Billing, Returns, and Customer Service.
* Proven leadership in SAP S/4HANA implementation or transformation programs.
* Experience designing and delivering end\-to\-end Lead\-to\-Cash and Order\-to\-Cash business processes.
* Experience integrating SAP with Salesforce and related commercial platforms.
* Experience leveraging AI, automation, and analytics to improve business and delivery outcomes.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills with the ability to influence senior business and technology leaders.


**Desired Qualifications**
* Salesforce CRM architecture and integration experience.
* Experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), APIs, middleware, and event\-driven integrations.
* Knowledge of SAP Customer Experience (CX), SAP BRIM, and advanced OTC process optimization.
